defmodule CryptoVault.Archive do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles encrypted archive processing with rate limiting and retry logic.
  Supports importing encrypted key bundles distributed as compressed archives.
  """

  require Logger

  @max_retries 3
  @retry_delay_ms 500
  @rate_limit_window_ms 60_000
  @max_requests_per_window 10
  @max_archive_size 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10 MB compressed
  @max_entry_count 100
  @max_decompressed_size 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50 MB total decompressed
  @max_single_file_size 5 * 1024 * 1024   # 5 MB per file

  defmodule RateLimiter do
    use GenServer

    def start_link(opts \\ []) do
      GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
    end

    def init(_) do
      {:ok, %{requests: [], window_ms: 60_000, max_requests: 10}}
    end

    def check_rate(pid) do
      GenServer.call(pid, :check_rate)
    end

    def handle_call(:check_rate, _from, state) do
      now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
      cutoff = now - state.window_ms
      recent = Enum.filter(state.requests, fn t -> t > cutoff end)

      if length(recent) >= state.max_requests do
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, %{state | requests: recent}}
      else
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | requests: [now | recent]}}
      end
    end
  end

  defmodule CryptoProcessor do
    @doc "Verifies HMAC signature of archive content before extraction."
    def verify_and_decrypt(archive_bytes, hmac_key, aes_key) do
      case archive_bytes do
        <<hmac_sig::binary-size(32), iv::binary-size(16), ciphertext::binary>>
        when byte_size(ciphertext) > 0 ->
          computed_hmac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, hmac_key, iv <> ciphertext)

          if :crypto.hash_equals(computed_hmac, hmac_sig) do
            plaintext = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, aes_key, iv, ciphertext,
              encrypt: false, padding: :pkcs_padding)
            {:ok, plaintext}
          else
            {:error, :invalid_signature}
          end

        _ ->
          {:error, :malformed_archive}
      end
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Imports an encrypted key bundle archive. The archive is first authenticated,
  decrypted, then decompressed. Rate limiting and retry logic handle transient failures.
  """
  def import_key_bundle(encrypted_archive, hmac_key, aes_key, rate_limiter_pid) do
    with_retry(fn ->
      case RateLimiter.check_rate(rate_limiter_pid) do
        :ok ->
          process_archive(encrypted_archive, hmac_key, aes_key)
        {:error, :rate_limited} ->
          {:error, :rate_limited}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp process_archive(encrypted_archive, hmac_key, aes_key) do
    if byte_size(encrypted_archive) > @max_archive_size do
      {:error, :archive_too_large}
    else
      case CryptoProcessor.verify_and_decrypt(encrypted_archive, hmac_key, aes_key) do
        {:ok, zip_data} ->
          extract_keys_from_zip(zip_data)
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  defp extract_keys_from_zip(zip_data) do
    case :zip.zip_open(zip_data, [:memory]) do
      {:ok, handle} ->
        try do
          case :zip.zip_list_dir(handle) do
            {:ok, entries} ->
              file_entries = Enum.filter(entries, fn
                {:zip_file, _, _, _, _, _} -> true
                _ -> false
              end)

              if length(file_entries) > @max_entry_count do
                {:error, :too_many_entries}
              else
                extract_all_entries(handle, file_entries)
              end
            {:error, reason} ->
              {:error, {:zip_error, reason}}
          end
        after
          :zip.zip_close(handle)
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:zip_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp extract_all_entries(handle, entries) do
    results = Enum.reduce_while(entries, {:ok, [], 0}, fn entry, {:ok, acc, total_size} ->
      {:zip_file, name, _info, _comment, _offset, _comp_size} = entry
      case :zip.zip_get(name, handle) do
        {:ok, {_name, content}} ->
          content_size = byte_size(content)
          new_total = total_size + content_size

          cond do
            content_size > @max_single_file_size ->
              {:halt, {:error, {:file_too_large, name, content_size}}}
            new_total > @max_decompressed_size ->
              {:halt, {:error, {:decompressed_size_exceeded, new_total}}}
            true ->
              {:cont, {:ok, [{name, content} | acc], new_total}}
          end
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:halt, {:error, {:extraction_failed, name, reason}}}
      end
    end)

    case results do
      {:ok, key_files, _total} ->
        validate_key_files(key_files)
      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  defp validate_key_files(key_files) do
    valid_keys = Enum.filter(key_files, fn {name, content} ->
      String.ends_with?(to_string(name), ".pem") and
      byte_size(content) > 0 and
      String.contains?(to_string(content), "-----BEGIN")
    end)

    {:ok, valid_keys}
  end

  defp with_retry(fun, attempt \\ 1) do
    case fun.() do
      {:error, :rate_limited} when attempt < @max_retries ->
        Process.sleep(@retry_delay_ms * attempt)
        with_retry(fun, attempt + 1)
      result ->
        result
    end
  end
end
